column1: # Sources: current data/runtime/translations.tsv, data/runtime/procedural-word-senses.tsv, former remnant
# and divine-textile tables. New gaps are scoped here, never global word senses.
# These are grammatical roles, not a rule to strip 质: dream/cloud/glitch stuff
# retain their established substance names. Native Lua defines the combinations.
# Healing substances: adjective senses refer to the material, not personality,
# arithmetic (odd), blood (goo), or fate (weird). No ordinary glossary changes.
# Divine metals retain their established complete names in both roles.
# Divine silk keeps its equipment qualifiers without an added material suffix.
# Substance nouns do not append silk to a native essence name.
# Evil-weather materials are also STATE_NAME_ADJ substances in native Lua.
